page.layout: One page of running text, one column, no margin notes. Printed page number top left. Running head top centre. Gathering signature bottom right.

main_text.p: ris Asiæ cœtus, & quidem ex Hebræis collectos agit; partim quod de his ipsis, de quibus Petrus, Paulus aliàs disertiùs longè ac prolixius disseruerit.

IX. Secundò, urgeri potest, Petrũ loco memorato reflectere ad Epistolã quandã Ecclesijs minoris Asiæ transmissam; Illam verò, de cujus authore instituta quæstio, videri data ad illos Hebræorum, qui Hie-rosolymis, qui inpalæstinâ, quos sæpe Paulus τὰς Ἐκκλησίας τῆς Ἰουδαίας, τὰς ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ, Gal. 1.22.1. Thess. ii.14. &c. Hos proprie Hebræos, priores Hellenistas nūcupatos, & in hac sententiâ esse doctissimos Interpretes. Quin dū author Epistolæ ad eos se venturū pollicetur Hebr. xiii.23. verosimillimū esse, eodē illos egisse in loco nec per tot provincias fuisse divisos. Atqui primò, peccatur falsâ hypothesi, Epistolam ad Hebræos, illos spectasse tantùm, qui Hierosolymis, aut certè in Palæstinâ. Imò verò & ad Palæstinas & ad alias extrà Palæstinam Ecclesias directam esse colligimus. 1. Ex inscriptione, πρὸς Ἑβραίους, indefinitè, nec limitato loco, adeoque communis illa fuerit, Hebræorum genti.

page.notes: Printed without spaces in the scan: "sæpePaulus", which is transcribed here as "sæpe Paulus". The first Greek phrase ("τὰς Ἐκκλησίας") is read from the scan and could be a little uncertain in its accents. The running head "Authore" is set in a decorative, black-letter-like face in the scan but is transcribed in roman. Hebrew and Greek are kept in Greek letters as printed. The signature "II." at bottom right is only partly legible.
